'''Branno''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Dread War]] on [[Oricon]] in [[3638 BBY]], Branno was among the Republic fleet send to end the threat of [[Dread Masters]]. However, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] overwhelmed the men with dread while the fleet was still in orbit and many ships crashed onto the moons service, while some men like Branno jettisoned in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Upon reaching surface, Branno was unexpectedly rescued by Imperials and was brought to the [[Dread Executioners camp]]. There, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Hargrev]] offered Branno and other rescued Republic soldiers a temporary truce to strike against their common enemy: the Dread Masters. Branno was reluctant to the idea, but as neither side alone was strong enough to battle the [[Dread Host]], he had no choice but to aid the Empire.
